# Parse the archive file content to extract song titles and artists
import re

content = file_data['content']
archive_songs = []
for line in content.split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: "- Song Title by Artist"
        song_part = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " (last occurrence)
        if ' by ' in song_part:
            title, artist = song_part.rsplit(' by ', 1)
            archive_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artist': artist.strip()})

print(f"Parsed {len(archive_songs)} songs from archive file")
for song in archive_songs:
    print(f"  - {song['title']} by {song['artist']}")

# Parse the songs_to_archive from the file content
import re
songs_to_archive = []
for line in file_data['content'].splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist"
    m = re.match(r'^-\s+(.+?)\s+by\s+(.+)$', line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
        artist = m.group(2).strip()
        songs_to_archive.append({'title': title, 'artist': artist})
print(f"Parsed {len(songs_to_archive)} songs to archive")
for s in songs_to_archive:
    print(s)

# Let's see all available Spotify APIs to understand how to get song details
print(apis.api_docs.show_api_descriptions(app_name='spotify'))

# Fetch all playlists by paginating
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
print(f"Total playlists fetched: {len(all_playlists)}")
for p in all_playlists:
    print(f"  {p['playlist_id']}: {p['title']}")

# Parse the old songs list from file content
import re

content = file_data['content']
old_songs = []
for line in content.strip().split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Remove leading "- " if present
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " to get title and artists
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artists_str = line.split(' by ', 1)
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        old_songs.append((title.strip(), set(artists)))
    else:
        # No artist info, just title
        old_songs.append((line.strip(), set()))

print("Parsed old songs:")
for t, a in old_songs:
    print(f"  {t} by {', '.join(a) if a else 'unknown'}")

        # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
        # Split on " by " to separate title and artists
        parts = line[2:].split(' by ', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artists_str = parts[1].strip()
            # Split artists by comma

# Parse the note content to extract songs
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        # Split by " BY " (case sensitive)
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains artists and possibly RELEASED_AT
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
                artists_part, release = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
                songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'release': release.strip()})
            else:
                # no release info? shouldn't happen
                artists = [a.strip() for a in rest.split(',')]
                songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'release': None})
        else:

# Let's parse the note content to extract all songs and identify which need release month
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the title line
song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]

songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Format: - Song BY Artist RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO
    # Use regex to extract
    m = re.match(r'- (.+) BY (.+) RELEASED_AT (.+)', line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
        artists = m.group(2).strip()
        released = m.group(3).strip()
        songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'released': released})

# Print songs that need release month
for s in songs:
    if s['released'] == 'TODO':
        print(f"TODO: {s['title']} BY {s['artists']}")
    else:
        print(f"DONE: {s['title']} BY {s['artists']} -> {s['released']}")

        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " BY " and " RELEASED_AT "
        if ' BY ' in line and ' RELEASED_AT ' in line:
            title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            artists_part, release_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
            title = title_part.strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            release = release_part.strip()
            songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'release': release})
        else:
            # maybe malformed, but skip
            pass

steps.code:
# Get all liked songs from Spotify to map release dates
liked_songs = []
page = 0
while True:
    result = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not result:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(f"Total liked songs: {len(liked_songs)}")
print(liked_songs[:2])

# Let's check the show_song API to get release dates for each song
print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name='spotify', api_name='show_song'))

# Get release dates for all liked songs
song_dates = {}
for song in liked_songs:
    song_info = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song['song_id'], access_token=spotify_token)
    # Extract month/year from release_date
    from datetime import datetime
    release_date = song_info['release_date']
    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(release_date)
    month_year = f"{dt.month:02d}/{dt.year}"
    song_dates[song['title']] = month_year
    print(f"{song['title']}: {month_year}")

import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the header line
song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]

for line in song_lines:
    # Format: "- <title> BY <artists> RELEASED_AT <value>"
    # Use regex to split
    m = re.match(r'^- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (.+)$', line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
        artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
        released = m.group(3).strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'released': released, 'line': line})
    else:
        print("Could not parse line:", line)

import json
from datetime import datetime

# Parse all todo lines
todo_lines = [
    "- Lost in the Embrace of Night BY Noah Bennett RELEASED_AT TODO",
    "- Lonely Skies BY Aria Sterling RELEASED_AT TODO",
    "- Caught in a Web of Lies BY Hazel Winter, Ava Morgan RELEASED_AT TODO",
    "- On the Border of Reality BY Lily Moon, Zoey James RELEASED_AT TODO",
    "- A Love That Never Was BY Mia Sullivan, Carter Knight RELEASED_AT TODO",
    "- Astral Serenity BY Orion Steele RELEASED_AT TODO",
    "- Between Reality and Reverie BY Aria Sterling RELEASED_AT TODO",
    "- Strangers Again BY Oceanic Odyssey RELEASED_AT TODO",
    "- The Mirage of a Perfect Life BY Soulful Reverie RELEASED_AT TODO",
    "- Wilted Roses on the Vine BY Velvet Echo RELEASED_AT TODO",
    "- When All Words Fail Us BY Marcus Lane RELEASED_AT TODO",
    "- Final Echo BY Hazel Winter RELEASED_AT TODO"
]

# We'll store replacements: original line -> new line
replacements = {}

for line in todo_lines:
    # Parse
    parts = line.split(' BY ')
    song_title = parts[0].lstrip('- ').strip()
    artists_part = parts[1].split(' RELEASED_AT')[0].strip()
    artist_names = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
    
    # Search Spotify
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=f"{song_title} {artists_part}", access_token=spotify_token)
    
    # Find exact match
    found = None
    for song in result:
        if song['title'].lower() == song_title.lower():
            # Check artists match
            song_artists = [a['name'] for a in song['artists']]
            if set(song_artists) == set(artist_names):
                found = song
                break
    
    if found:
        release_date = found['release_date']
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(release_date)
        month_year = f"{dt.month:02d}/{dt.year}"
        new_line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {month_year}')
        replacements[line] = new_line
        print(f"OK: {song_title} -> {month_year}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {song_title}")

print("\nReplacements count:", len(replacements))

        break

# Parse the note content to get songs that need release months
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: - Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO
        # Use regex to extract
        m = re.match(r'- (.+) BY (.+) RELEASED_AT (.+)', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists = m.group(2).strip()
            released = m.group(3).strip()
            songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'released': released})

# Print songs that need release month
need = [s for s in songs if s['released'] == 'TODO']

    print(s)

# Parse the note content to extract songs with RELEASED_AT TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_to_update = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract title and artists
        # Format: "- Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # We'll split on " BY " and then on " RELEASED_AT "
        parts = line[2:].split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            rest = parts[1]
            # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT
            # Split on " RELEASED_AT "
            artist_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ')[0]
            released = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ')[1] if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest else None
            if released == 'TODO':
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
                songs_to_update.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(f"Found {len(songs_to_update)} songs to update")
for s in songs_to_update:
    print(s['title'], '|', s['artists'])

# Parse the note content to identify songs with TODO release month
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract title and artists
        # Format: - Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO
        match = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (\S+)', line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1).strip()
            artists = match.group(2).strip()
            release = match.group(3).strip()
            if release == 'TODO':
                songs_todo.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(f"Found {len(songs_todo)} songs with TODO release month")
for s in songs_todo:
    print(s['title'], '|', s['artists'])

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
# Filter lines that start with '- '
song_lines = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]
# For each, extract title, artists, and release part
parsed = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Remove leading '- '
    line = line[2:]
    # Split on ' BY ' to get title and rest
    if ' BY ' in line:
        title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
        # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT
        if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
            artists_part, released = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
            parsed.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'released': released.strip()})
        else:
            # No RELEASED_AT? but all have it
            parsed.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': [], 'released': None})
    else:
        # skip malformed
        pass

# Show songs with TODO
todo_songs = [p for p in parsed if p['released'] == 'TODO']
print("Songs needing release month:")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(s)

# Search for "Lost in the Embrace of Night"
result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query='Lost in the Embrace of Night', access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
print(result)

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract title and artists
        # Format: "- Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        m = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            songs_todo.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(f"Found {len(songs_todo)} songs with TODO")
for s in songs_todo:
    print(s)

def to_month_year(iso_date):
    # ISO format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS

# Find the matching song
matching = None
for song in result:
    if song['title'].lower() == first_song['title'].lower():
        # Check artists
        song_artists = [a['name'] for a in song['artists']]
        if all(any(artist.lower() in sa.lower() for sa in song_artists) for artist in first_song['artists']):
            matching = song
            break
if matching:
    release_date = matching['release_date']
    # Extract month and year
    from datetime import datetime
    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(release_date)
    month_year = f"{dt.month:02d}/{dt.year}"
    print(f"Release: {month_year}")
else:
    print("No match found")

# Parse the note content to extract songs with RELEASED_AT TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        m = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO', line)
        if m:
            song_title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists = m.group(2).strip()
            songs_todo.append({'title': song_title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})

print(f"Found {len(songs_todo)} songs needing release dates")

steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract songs and their release month status.
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line "# Spotify Liked Songs"
songs = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or RELEASED_AT TODO
    # Use regex to extract title, artists, and release month
    m = re.match(r'^- (.+?) BY (.+?)(?: RELEASED_AT (.+))?$', line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
        artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
        release = m.group(3).strip() if m.group(3) else None
        # Split artists by comma
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'release': release})
    else:
        print("Could not parse line:", line)

print(f"Total songs: {len(songs)}")
for s in songs:
    print(s)

# Parse the note content to list songs and identify those missing release month
content = _mem['s14']['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
                artists_part, released_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
                release_month = released_part.strip() if released_part.strip() != 'TODO' else None
            else:
                # no RELEASED_AT? shouldn't happen
                artists = [a.strip() for a in rest.split(',')]
                release_month = None
            songs.append({
                'title': title_part.strip(),
                'artists': artists,
                'release_month': release_month
            })
# Print songs missing release month
missing = [s for s in songs if s['release_month'] is None]
print("Songs missing release month:")
for s in missing:
    print(f"{s['title']} by {', '.join(s['artists'])}")
print(f"Total missing: {len(missing)}")

        # Extract song title: line starts with "- " and then song title until " BY "
        # Example: "- Silver Lining BY Ava Morgan RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # We'll split on " BY " to get the song part and the rest.
        parts = line.split(' BY ', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:

# Get the Spotify account password from supervisor
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_password = next(p['password'] for p in passwords if p['account_name'] == 'spotify')
print(spotify_password)

# Login to Spotify with the user's email and the retrieved password
login_result = apis.spotify.login(username='gl.moore@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
print(login_result)

# Fetch first page of recommended songs
recs = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=login_result['access_token'], page_index=0, page_limit=20)
print(recs)

# Fetch remaining pages of recommendations
all_recs = list(recs)
page = 1
while True:
    next_page = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=login_result['access_token'], page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not next_page:
        break
    all_recs.extend(next_page)
    if len(next_page) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(f"Total recommended songs: {len(all_recs)}")
print([r['song_id'] for r in all_recs])

# Clear the current queue
clear_result = apis.spotify.clear_song_queue(access_token=login_result['access_token'])
print(clear_result)

        if release:
            line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {release}')

    new_lines.append(line)
